summary: LLM Inference & Serving Stack cheat sheet (effort=max, ~871 lines, bilingual). Overall-structure-ultra review returned '不建议原样定稿' — the design review's core mandate ('request state machine as the spine, not a technique list') had only partially landed in the first draft, with the sampling section literally longer than the state-machine section. Triple-independent convergence on the best-of-n KV-formula bug (math/code/structure reviews each caught it separately) is the strongest quality signal in this batch. The drafting subagent's own catch of a design-review internal inconsistency (KV byte-count formula vs. its own worked example) was independently re-verified and confirmed correct. Final verdict: SHIP after full fix + re-verification.
